principles: degrade one subsystem at a time instead of collapsing the full experience
preserve user trust by stating what is unavailable without overstating success
never convert missing data into fabricated data
preserve Isabel identity, authority boundaries, office geometry, and continuity during recovery
prefer last-known-good state only when it is explicitly labeled stale and still safe to show

pixel_streaming.failure: browser loses Unreal stream or WebRTC cannot connect
pixel_streaming.degraded_mode: show live-office shell with renderer-offline status, preserve controls disabled except reconnect and diagnostics
pixel_streaming.recovery: retry with exponential backoff, restore previous continuity state after renderer returns
never: pretend Isabel is still visually present

screen_data.failure: one or more monitor routes fail
screen_data.degraded_mode: keep physical monitor present and display controlled fallback with last-good timestamp
screen_data.recovery: retry only the failed screen independently
never: replace failed data with invented values

asr.failure: speech recognition unavailable or confidence too low
asr.degraded_mode: keep listening body language, request concise repeat or permit typed input
asr.recovery: retry ASR stream without restarting Unreal
never: guess a consequential command from low-confidence transcript

tts.degraded_mode: show concise text response and keep non-speaking facial state stable
tts.recovery: retry voice on next turn or after provider recovery
never: desynchronize mouth motion from missing audio

brain.failure: reasoning provider times out or returns invalid plan
brain.degraded_mode: remain responsive, acknowledge failure, preserve current office state, allow simple deterministic commands
brain.recovery: retry with bounded fallback model/provider if configured
never: execute a partially validated consequential plan

navigation.failure: path unavailable, blocked, or movement timeout
navigation.degraded_mode: stop safely at current location, face user or nearest valid target, explain movement is unavailable if relevant
navigation.recovery: repath once, then use stationary explanation rather than teleporting
never: clip through desk, chairs, monitor wall, or windows

facial_performance.degraded_mode: neutral attentive face with eye/head behavior only
facial_performance.recovery: rebind facial rig without recreating character actor
never: swap to a different face or identity

memory.degraded_mode: operate session-local only and disclose durable memory is temporarily unavailable when relevant
memory.recovery: reconnect and reconcile by source/version, never blind overwrite

evidence.failure: source connector unavailable, stale, contradictory, or missing
evidence.degraded_mode: show known facts, mark stale/unknown fields, gather alternate evidence
evidence.recovery: refresh source independently and recompute affected conclusions

action_execution.degraded_mode: mark execution failed, retain exact approved payload and do not claim success
action_execution.recovery: retry only if approval remains valid for unchanged payload or request approval again
never: treat attempted execution as verified result

severity_levels.DEGRADED: one feature unavailable but Isabel remains useful
severity_levels.FATAL: identity, authority, evidence integrity, or geometry integrity is compromised

acceptance: single subsystem failures do not restart the entire office
failed monitor data remains isolated to the affected monitor
voice failure never causes fake lip sync
external action failure is visible and auditable
all degraded states have an explicit recovery path
